name: clipnode-media-mcp
description: MCP bridge for ClipNode local media export and interactive session editing.

interface.shortDescription: Control ClipNode media export and live edit-session patches through MCP.
interface.longDescription: Adds MCP tools, a workflow resource, and a workflow prompt that expose ClipNode local media capabilities, phone media browsing, file upload/download, task validation, serial export jobs, HLS m3u8 to MP4 export, job status, outputs, transition tags, sticker animation capabilities, built-in reference templates, and interactive AI patch editing for the currently open ClipNode media-session draft, including compact current-state reads and text/image/GIF sticker patches.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use ClipNode Media MCP as a local media workflow. For new export jobs: read capabilities, upload/probe sources, validate the task, create one queued job, poll status, then download successful outputs. When the user is already on the ClipNode edit/session page and asks AI to modify the current draft, call clipnode_edit_get_current_state, prefer compact=true for targeting reads, use editableIndex ids, validate/apply a small patch with baseRevision, and read idMap for newly created objects. Current session patches can add text, image, or GIF stickers; probe GIF stickers with includeFrameTimeline=true and pass gif.frameTimeList. Prefer the MCP tools over manual curl checks. Do not use sandboxed curl/wget/ad-hoc HTTP scripts for CLIPNODE_BASE_URL, localhost, LAN, Android device, emulator, or ADB-forwarded endpoints; if a real HTTP request is necessary, request sandbox_permissions=require_escalated and explain the endpoint, purpose, and expected effect.
